angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 7,523,417 km at 100.73 pc = 1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.9280 +/- 0.0383 mas (same row, RUWE 0.89): 100.73 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 10.814 (10.594 to 11.034) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 7,523,417 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.002 (2.599 to 3.042) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4943 +/- 8.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1693159194226600192: teff_gspphot 4942.6973 K (16th-84th percentiles 4934.4336-4950.7627), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1693159194226600192: teff_gspphot 4942.6973 K (16th-84th percentiles 4934.4336-4950.7627), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tonatiuh.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.847, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 104985 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 III, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 104985 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.32 dex, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 104985 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.76989, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 104985: projected rotation speed 2.7 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
